title: DTRT Afterlight
subtitle: La isla recuerda
hook: His mother has been dead for fifteen years. Someone has learned how to make her ask for help.
description: Gabriel Vélez hears his dead mother's voice on a call from his missing sister. Following the evidence across Puerto Rico, he discovers how a useful service network became a machinery of disappearance—and why telling the whole truth could endanger the people he is trying to protect.
attribution: A story developed for Ian Ferraro and DTRT Lab.

chapters.title: The completed journey
chapters.alt: Pre-dawn electronics shop, rolling door half open, radio on the workbench, a delivery truck on wet asphalt.
chapters.cut: A transmitter that no longer exists. A workbench lamp left on.
chapters.insight: Gabriel is introduced by a repair he cannot finish. The story will keep asking what can be restored and what can only be recorded.
chapters.blurb: A radio. A call. A name marked complete a day early.

chapters.title: Dead air
chapters.alt: Open gate at a quiet communications compound, white truck idling under an unlit camera.
chapters.cut: The building has stopped making the noises Inés complained about.
chapters.insight: Quiet is information. Before anyone fires, the station has already failed its ordinary sounds.
chapters.blurb: The station is too quiet. Someone is still inside.

chapters.title: The blue door
chapters.alt: A weathered blue wooden door strapped to a flatbed truck on a residential street.
chapters.cut: Pencil marks on the inner edge. A family that paper tried to relocate.
chapters.insight: A contractor file is not a deed. Lucía's method is the story's method: what you saw, then what you think.
chapters.blurb: A reporter, a lawyer, and a door that records a family.

chapters.title: The woman with the radio
chapters.alt: Dry coastal agricultural yard, bright ground, pickup truck, wind on loose roofing.
chapters.cut: Southwest light. A meeting outside protected habitat.
chapters.insight: The island is not one texture. The southwest is written as exposed ground on purpose.
chapters.blurb: Dry light, a dispatcher, and sheets she signed.

chapters.title: The price of a familiar voice
chapters.alt: A cluttered radio workshop with stairs to a living space above.
chapters.cut: Four hospitals. No parking. A household that still has to eat.
chapters.insight: A family dinner is allowed to be ordinary. When trust breaks, it has to cost a real kitchen.
chapters.blurb: A workshop over a kitchen. A voice that knows too much.

chapters.title: The house with no address
chapters.alt: Night at a mountain community shelter converted from a family workshop.
chapters.cut: The mailing address exists. The service map placed it outside help.
chapters.insight: Alma's correction is the book's: a missing support polygon is not the same as a place that does not exist.
chapters.blurb: A shelter the map declined to support.

chapters.title: The longer road
chapters.alt: A worn red bag, a small recorder, and an open radio chassis on a wooden table.
chapters.cut: They stay a day. The original material is allowed to take time.
chapters.insight: Repairing a radio is not a side quest. The longer road is the point.
chapters.blurb: Not the shortest route. A day spent keeping context.

chapters.title: Observed and authorized
chapters.alt: Portrait of Inés Vélez at a security door, two coffees in hand.
chapters.cut: A visitor badge. Coffee without sugar. A sister who still knows the order.
chapters.insight: Access that looks official is still a choice. The sibling detail is not a cipher.
chapters.blurb: A reunion that does not start with forgiveness.

chapters.title: The people between entries
chapters.alt: The blue door on a truck, used here as occupancy evidence rather than a relic.
chapters.cut: Receipts, a disputed boundary, a roof repaired by someone who left.
chapters.insight: Occupancy is a disagreement, not a blank. Lucía will not flatten it into a perfect family with perfect papers.
chapters.blurb: Lives that do not fit the fields.

chapters.title: The rehearsal
chapters.alt: A leased analysis building in humid northeastern uplands, late afternoon.
chapters.cut: A visit that can still leave. Estimates, not magic future footage.
chapters.insight: The encounter is planned, witnessed, and abandonable. A system that practices people should show its gaps.
chapters.blurb: A diagnostic window. A building that watches back.

chapters.title: A voice that would wait
chapters.alt: A portable electronic sign at dawn, two overlapping circles, one incomplete.
chapters.cut: Publication is a craft. Some names are not sent through the channel you happen to have.
chapters.insight: Telling everything is not automatically the moral action. Care is part of the record.
chapters.blurb: What to print. What to protect. What to wait for.

chapters.title: What the fortifications could not hold
chapters.alt: A privately leased archive room in a townhouse, files on a table, a high window.
chapters.cut: Not a monument. Not a server fortress. A room where an audit can still be curated.
chapters.insight: The old city is geography, not a boss arena. The decision that matters is whether the record can be trimmed.
chapters.blurb: An archive. A cost that cannot be managed away.

chapters.title: No one left in the truck
chapters.alt: Night at a contractor transfer yard, sodium lights, wet concrete, truck bays.
chapters.cut: Workers, not paper, become the immediate problem.
chapters.insight: Opening a truck is not the same as saving a case alone. Other people preserved the evidence.
chapters.blurb: The yard. The people still inside the work.

chapters.title: The living record
chapters.alt: The repair shop at dusk, rolling door up, a small table set for dinner.
chapters.cut: Copies existed before the fire. Forgiveness starts with an object between two people.
chapters.insight: The investigation does not end because one room filled with smoke. Repair is slower than a journey.
chapters.blurb: What remains. What he can actually fix.

chapters.title: Someone is here
chapters.alt: Close view of a vintage radio and a family photograph on a workbench.
chapters.cut: Dinner first. The receiver stays on.
chapters.insight: Volume One is resolved. The next problem is not a reason to pretend this one did not matter.
chapters.blurb: A modest broadcast. A table. A message that can wait ten minutes.
